entry_surfaces./: High-density command dashboard — executive telemetry headers, live 14D polytope projection canvas, and streaming constraint violation feed

grids.mode: MODE B: High Density Dashboard Grid
grids.dashboard_layout: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 p-6

layouts.header: Fixed top navigation bar with Prussian Blue background (#002147), Metallic Gold accents (#D4AF37), status indicators, and simulator stream toggle.
layouts.sidebar_or_tabs: Tabbed view switcher for Overview KPI, Live 14D Stream, Polytope Canvas 2D Slice, Constraint Editor (Ax <= b), Event Log, Audit Trail.
layouts.card_style: Cardless or sharp 1px slate-indigo stroke cards with dark void background (#090F1E), inset spacing p-5.

rules: Live vector point projections move smoothly across 2D plane with spring transition
Violations flash gentle gold/red border highlight for 600ms
Hover transitions on table rows and action triggers set to 150ms ease-out
Minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for all body and muted text tokens against respective surface backgrounds
High visibility focus indicators with 2px ring ring-offset-2 ring-[#D4AF37]
Interactive non-text glyphs have explicit aria-label and data-testid attributes
Data charts use distinct stroke dash patterns alongside color for high contrast accessibility

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind v4 CSS variables defined in frontend/src/index.css along with fontsource imports.
Implement the full 14D Polytope Mathematical Framework: Convex polytope P = {x in R^14 : Ax <= b}, residual vector r = Ax - b, max residual max(r).
Include a live synthetic vector stream simulator with start/pause controls, latency injection, and violation probability toggles.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, canvas nodes, and tab triggers carry explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-simulator-btn').
Use standard recharts for telemetry histograms and multi-axis performance graphs.

Provide interactive 2D slice projection canvas where user selects dimension X (e.g. Dim 1: Toxicity) vs dimension Y (e.g. Dim 4: Concentration), showing linear hyperplane boundaries and projected state points.

Provide editable constraint matrix editor (A matrix 14 rows x 14 cols, b threshold vector 14 elements) with preset safety profiles ('Biochemical Safeguard Strict', 'Clinical Trial Safety', 'Permissive Test Mode').
Render clear status badges using Prussian Blue, Dark Khaki, Metallic Gold, and Slate Indigo.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Do not default to generic centered cards. Use sharp tactical borders, dense grid spacing, high-contrast monospace metadata, and live streaming mathematical telemetry.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: Always maintain explicit background and foreground pairs as listed in colors.surfaces.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain crisp, dense inner padding p-4 or p-6 with direct clear alignment.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_readiness: Every action button, tab item, filter control, modal trigger, and data row must have unambiguous data-testid attributes.
